class.name: OcgGCMakesegment
class.brief_description: Implements construction algorithms for line segments in 3D space. The result is a `Geom_TrimmedCurve`. A `GC_MakeSegment` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and resulting segment via `Value()`.

method.description: Creates a segment of a line from two points.
